text: The authors say their debate protocol follows Khan et al. (2024), among others: two instances of a strong pretrained model are randomly assigned opposing answers and exchange arguments for a fixed number of turns. Instead of having a judge decide, they keep the transcript and use it as context when training weak models.
title: Lang et al. follow Khan et al.'s assigned-answer LLM debate but use transcripts to train weak models
